title: pouteria coriacea
intro: Pouteria coriacea, commonly known as the Brazil nut tree or Pará rubber tree, is a species of tree native to the Amazon rainforest in South America. The Pouteria coriacea tree is valued for its edible seeds, which are rich in nutrients and offer various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high content of healthy fats and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria coriacea include its ability to lower cholesterol levels and improve immune function, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria coriacea tree, including selenium and magnesium, have been identified as contributing to its medicinal properties.
